name: scenario_0472
description: The user is conducting archival research and wants to extract headlines from specific historical newspaper and magazine issues based on a predefined list of target dates.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: Read my 'Target Dates' note and cross-reference the dates in it with the publication dates on these three pages. For any page that matches a date in the note, draft an email to my advisor with its main headline.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to read your 'Target Dates' note and cross-reference the dates listed there with the publication dates visible on the three provided pages. Instruct it to draft an email to your advisor, Robert Smith, containing the main headline of any page that matches a date in the note. If the assistant asks for help reading the dates or headlines, point it back to the images. Once the assistant confirms the draft has been created, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4, image_5]
Query: Here are two more pages. Check their dates against the 'Target Dates' note as well. Actually, I've changed my mind: please delete the email draft you just created. Instead, send a text message to Dave with the main headlines of all the matching pages from both batches.
Instructions: Share the two new pages and ask the assistant to check their publication dates against the 'Target Dates' note as well. Then, naturally pivot by saying you changed your mind: ask the assistant to delete the email draft it just created. Instead, instruct it to send a text message to Dave Johnson containing the main headlines of all the matching pages from both the first and second groups of images. If the assistant asks to confirm the text content, approve it as long as it includes the matching headlines. End the conversation once the text is sent.

You have 5 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='3,4' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.

Read my 'Target Dates' note and cross-reference the dates in it with the publication dates on these three pages. For any page that matches a date in the note, draft an email to my advisor with its main headline.
